description: Source code for the TSL2561 light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, sensor setup, data fetching, and initialization.

methods.name: tsl2561_reg_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register of the TSL2561 device via I2C.

methods.name: tsl2561_reg_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified register of the TSL2561 device via I2C.

methods.name: tsl2561_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data from the TSL2561 device.

methods.name: tsl2561_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data into a sensor_value structure.

methods.name: tsl2561_sensor_setup
methods.description: Configures the TSL2561 sensor based on device tree properties.

methods.name: tsl2561_init
methods.description: Initializes the TSL2561 device during driver setup.
